description: Search Infrabase.ai, a hand-verified directory of AI infrastructure products: inference APIs, GPU clouds, vector databases, agent frameworks, observability, gateways and more. Filter by free text, category, job (what the product does) or European headquarters. Returns each product's name, slug, tagline, jobs, pricing model, HQ country, icon and links, plus the total match count. Each result's slug is accepted by get_tool and find_alternatives. CC-BY-4.0. Each result includes an infrabase_url for attribution.

category.description: Directory category to browse, e.g. vector-databases

gdpr.description: true: only products that state GDPR compliance

job.description: What the product does for a developer, e.g. vector-database, llm-gateway, speech-to-text. Matches primary and secondary jobs.

query.description: Free text search across name, tagline, description and jobs

name: search_tools
title: Search AI infrastructure tools
